name: singstat
description: Find, retrieve, compare, and explain official Singapore statistics using the SingStat MCP tools.

interface.longDescription: Explore official Singapore economic, population, household, industry, trade, and social statistics. Find relevant SingStat tables, inspect metadata, retrieve data, and compare figures with citations to the source tables and periods.
defaultPrompt: Find the relevant SingStat table, retrieve official data, and cite the table and period used.
